viv: Quick sync — AeroPulse agreed to a short customer spotlight + webinar mention. Need: 1-line quote, consent for clips/logo, recording slot, and webinar signup routing. Brief: https://drive.redwood.com/aeropulse-brief

raja: I can run the interview. Tue 9:00am PT works for me. 20m should be enough.

ting: Producer here — Tue 9am PT good. I'll set Zoom + Otter, capture transcript, plan a 90s promo and a 15s teaser. Will request hi-res logo and headshot.

ellie-sales: For routing: use utm_campaign=aeropulse-announce and add hidden field product_interest=aeropulse. SF queue = SDR_AeroPulse. Tag leads with "aeropulse_webinar". If company_size > 1000, route to AE team.

sophie-legal: Legal notes: we require explicit consent wording covering case page, social, webinar repurposing, and short clips. Any metric must include a measurement window and state it’s from an "aggregated production workload." Avoid comparative vendor claims. Paste the exact final quote + consent here for review.

viv: Draft quote to propose on call: "AeroPulse cut our inference costs by ~41% and lowered p95 latency from ~790ms to ~240ms on our November production workload."

Consent template: "By approving this quote, AeroPulse grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote and associated case study materials (transcript excerpts, short video clips, and summary statistics) for marketing and sales purposes, and to use AeroPulse's name and logo in those materials."

raja: I'll ask for a 1-sentence hero variant and logo permission on the call. Will paste their reply here.

vid-bot: Reminder: submit /legal-review with final quote + consent. Target SLA 48h.

sophie-legal: If they only provided aggregated metrics, no DPA required. If any raw logs were shared, we need a DPA + security checklist.

viv: Action items:
- Raja: capture 1-line exec quote + consent + logo permission on call (due EOD Tue)
- Ting: calendar + recording setup + promo edit plan (invite sent)
- Ellie: implement form fields + SF queue wiring (SDR_AeroPulse + product_interest + utm_campaign)
- Sophie: legal to review final quote once submitted (48h SLA)

viv: Goal: publish case spotlight the week after next, social promo same day, webinar 7-10 days after publish if legal signs off. :thumbsup:
